response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.a, p.a - b1.m AS e1 FROM p, b1 WHERE p.a > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a, k.e1, k.a - b2.m AS e2 FROM k, b2 WHERE k.a > b2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(e2) AS avg_second_excess FROM f
